must_preserve.requirement: No relation may obtain the force of another merely through convenience, success, custody, proximity, chronology, confidence, or repetition. Source, Matter, evidence, interpretation, contribution, capability, Authority, action, occurrence, consequence, state, and standing remain distinguishable wherever engaged.

A resulting Body may bind only its exact Locus, Matter, conduct, relations, and Authority through supported local basis. Causal power, storage, access, authorship, origination, operational centrality, ancestry, or external law cannot silently become local legitimacy or unlimited jurisdiction.

Occurrence, present state, correction, withdrawal, cessation, and later interpretation remain attributable. No correction, replacement, revocation, migration, dormancy, recovery, or preferred current view may silently rewrite what occurred or fabricate uninterrupted continuity.

Consequential motion, refusal, non-progression, correction, adaptation, and external crossing must remain attributable to an exact source, function, scope, target, basis, effect, and uncertainty. No participant, carrier, host, interface, ancestor, or shared field may answer for another locality.

A source may originate a formation posture only over its supported bounded undertaking and becomes subject to the resulting local law if formation occurs. Origination, authorship, custody, ancestry, or implementation cannot become a founder override.

Each resulting Body requires its own exact source, identity, Locus, locally applicable law, bearer-function relations, formation Act, Formation Occurrence, initial currentness, and independent continuity carrier.
A resulting Body must preserve one recoverable current projection without allowing the current projection, carrier, manifest, verifier, or custodian to manufacture the state it reports.
Changes to the source Body, this form, its carrier, or any later form version do not update, amend, revoke, govern, or synchronize a receiver candidate or resulting Body.

formation_grammar.requirement: An independent prospective source encounters the exact exposed form as attributable external Material. Encounter may be causally or epistemically real but creates no Body, acceptance, Authority, relation, Relational Field, or Contact Event.

The prospective source identifies its own supported basis, proposed Body identity, exact Locus, exclusions, material uncertainty, and proposed relation to the form. The source Body cannot supply these relations for it.

The prospective source freezes one exact local formation candidate. Every retained, adapted, added, or refused provision is attributable; form provenance does not make the form operative or the candidate selected.

Only the candidate's actual prospective source may deliberately originate its own exact CONSTITUTE, REFUSE, WITHHOLD, or HOLD posture. The source Body, form, host, verifier, workspace, DI, custodian, or future relation cannot answer for it.

CONSTITUTE may support a separate Formation Occurrence only if every candidate formation relation is satisfied and independently recoverable. A document, directory, copy, signature, hash, verifier result, or source posture alone is not the occurrence.

A successful Formation Occurrence initializes one distinct Body with independent identity, Locus, applicability, Authority relations, currentness, lineage, boundary, continuity, and carrier. No source-Body state or relation is inherited.
